# ⚠️ Please Do Not Create an Issue to Submit Projects

We've moved to a pull request-based submission process to manage contributions to the Awesome Django list better.

## How to Submit Your Project

1. Fork the repository
2. Add your project to the appropriate category in `README.md`
3. Submit a pull request and fill out the [pull request template](https://github.com/wsvincent/awesome-django/blob/main/.github/pull_request_template.md) completely

## Submission Criteria

Before submitting, read [what we look for](https://github.com/wsvincent/awesome-django/blob/main/contributing.md#what-we-look-for) in the contribution guidelines. Paid products and company submissions must also meet the [commercial products and services](https://github.com/wsvincent/awesome-django/blob/main/contributing.md#commercial-products-and-services) rules.

## Need Help?

If you need assistance with the submission process:
1. Check our [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/wsvincent/awesome-django/blob/main/contributing.md)
2. Review existing pull requests for examples
3. [Open a discussion](https://github.com/wsvincent/awesome-django/discussions) if you have questions about the process

*Issues that submit a project will be closed. Please submit your project via pull request.*
